scope: Saved LocalEarningSequence prefab rendered by the existing fixture camera at three portrait sizes. Assessment, activating, activated, summary and the summary layout's diamond-preview variant use explicit synthetic text. A separate isolated copy switches through all five states and back to assessment without recreation, checking root exclusivity, hidden receipt/bonus groups, no added Buttons, visible artwork, text overflow and text containment. It also visits receipt then bonuses before restoring assessment, checking that the shared MessageDisclosure follows its Message group. These are Unity prefab previews, not phone or reference APK screenshots. No Host, service, player save or payment operation runs.

fixtures.scope: Fifteen actual camera renders of the saved message card; explicitly synthetic preview data.
